title: Year-round tours – Around the world
description: A 90-minute guided tour for school groups that crosses the zoo's continents to show how animals have adapted to their environments and to introduce biodiversity.

title: Interactive education programmes
description: Guided school programmes delivered as a commented walk or inside the Education Center, using worksheets, natural materials, contact animals, tablets and binoculars.

title: Zoo-Expedition school programme
description: A 90-minute guided programme for school classes, adapted to Berlin's curriculum and the group's age, available in German or English for up to 30 pupils.

title: Zoo School
description: Cologne Zoo's extracurricular Zoo School supplements science teaching with inquiry-based and discovery-based programmes aligned with North Rhine-Westphalia curriculum guidelines.

title: Guided Tours
description: Guided tours through Leipzig's theme worlds with zoo guides, bookable through the Safari Office at least four weeks in advance.

title: Morning experience
description: An early-morning tour before Schönbrunn opens, with exclusive access, a behind-the-scenes look and breakfast at the Kaiserpavillon.

title: Themed tours
description: 1.5-hour themed guided tours for families, friends or colleagues, with themes such as Highlights, Giants, On the Brink of Extinction and Africa Safari.

title: Guided Tours for Schools
description: Age-appropriate one-hour guided tours for preschool and school groups of up to 25 children, with themes such as the Lewa Savannah and Masoala Rainforest.

title: Workshops for Schools
description: Two- to three-hour hands-on workshops for preschool and school classes on topics such as Asian elephants, big cats and penguins, with games and creative activities.

title: Smartphone Photography Course
description: A photography course held across the zoo as part of Zurich's public Courses & Workshops programme, priced at CHF 119.

title: Visit ARTIS with your school
description: School visits across ARTIS Zoo, Micropia and the Planetarium combining interactive lessons, live shows and worksheets on nature and biodiversity.

title: Guided lessons for Primary Education
description: Year-level-tailored guided lessons at Diergaarde Blijdorp that challenge primary pupils to observe and discover animals and plants.

title: The Zoo Mission
description: An activity mission for children aged 5–12 with challenges, stamps and badges, plus workshops and live Zoo Stories, aimed at turning them into Nature Heroes.

title: School Tours
description: School trips combining a curriculum-linked workshop led by Dublin Zoo educators with the option of a self-guided visit at the class's own pace.

title: Education Workshops
description: Stand-alone hands-on workshops for children and families led by Dublin Zoo educators, using interactive investigation and creative activities.

title: Cultivating the Next Generation of Conservationists (teacher course)
description: A summer professional-development course for primary teachers on Education for Sustainable Development and conservation education, delivered in Dublin Zoo's Discovery and Learning Centre and grounds.

title: School visits with education class
description: Reduced-rate school visits that include a taught education session, available from nursery through tertiary level at Edinburgh Zoo.

title: Guided tours
description: Guided tours run by Frankfurt Zoo's Education Department for school classes of all ages and for teachers, students, educators and interested visitors.

title: Educational offer for schools
description: Barcelona Zoo's experiential school programme offers curriculum-linked activities that build scientific skills and understanding of biodiversity conservation.

title: Guided tours of the Zoo
description: A two-hour guided walk for grades 4–6 and older students covering the aquarium, birdhouse, great apes, elephants, rhinos, reptiles, giraffes, lions and hippos.

title: The ZOO Through the Magnifying Glass
description: A 90-minute workshop in which pupils examine preparations such as a rhino horn, polar bear fur, giraffe tail hair and butterfly wings at high magnification.

title: Educational talks
description: Daily talks by Beauval's scientific facilitators around the park about species' ways of life and behaviour, supplemented by recorded talks and feeding talks.
